what: crates/hir-ty/src/next_solver/fulfill/watch.rs: `Watches` derives Default, so `free` starts at 0 instead of NONE (u32::MAX); the first `link` then takes the free-list branch and indexes `self.nodes[0]` on an empty Vec (watch.rs:180, index out of bounds: len 0 index 0). 43 blaze-diagnostics tests (every body that runs the fulfillment loop) panic there. Fix: replace `#[derive(Debug, Default)]` with `#[derive(Debug)]` plus a manual `impl Default for Watches` that sets `free: NONE` (everything else default), or make free an Option. One line of behavior, no API change.

history.note: applied: watch.rs Watches has a manual Default with free: NONE (as unlink_all leaves it), every other field empty; derive is Debug only
